hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that extracts a 1% fee from every buy (in native ETH) and sell (in tokens), accumulating ETH into a burn pot used for periodic on-chain buyback-and-burn swaps; blocks exact-output swaps and sells in the same block as a buyback, and includes an allowlist in afterSwap that can selectively prevent sell-side swaps; the restriction can be enabled by any caller via compress(), while only the deployer can disable it and control which addresses are allowlisted.
